title: Store Content Management
description: Learn how to manage store content including homepage sections, product descriptions, and store pages using AI-powered content generation.
content:
Store Content Management

Tijraa's content management system allows you to create and manage all your store content, including homepage sections, product descriptions, and custom pages. You can also use AI to generate content automatically.

Accessing Content Management

To manage store content:

  1. Navigate to Stores in the sidebar
  2. Select your store
  3. Click on Content tab

Homepage Sections

Customize your store's homepage sections:

Hero Section

  • Main headline
  • Subheading
  • Call-to-action button
  • Background image

Categories Section

  • Featured categories
  • Category images
  • Category descriptions

Featured Products

  • Select products to feature
  • Product descriptions
  • Product images

Trending Products

  • Automatically show best-selling products
  • Or manually select products

Newsletter Section

  • Newsletter signup form
  • Custom message
  • Email collection

AI Content Generation

Use AI to generate content automatically:

Generate Product Descriptions

  1. Go to a product
  2. Click Generate with AI
  3. Provide product details
  4. AI generates description
  5. Review and edit if needed
  6. Save

Generate Homepage Content

  1. Go to Store Content
  2. Select a section
  3. Click Regenerate with AI
  4. AI creates content
  5. Customize as needed
  6. Save

Content Editor

The content editor includes:

  • Rich text formatting
  • Image insertion
  • Links
  • Lists
  • Headings

Custom Pages

Create custom pages for:

  • About Us
  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy
  • Shipping Information
  • Returns Policy
  • Any custom content

Creating Custom Pages

  1. Go to Custom Pages
  2. Click Create Page
  3. Enter page title
  4. Add content using the editor
  5. Set page slug (URL)
  6. Save and publish

SEO Optimization

For each section and page:

  • Add meta titles
  • Add meta descriptions
  • Use relevant keywords
  • Optimize images with alt text

Content Templates

Use pre-built templates for common content:

  • Product descriptions
  • Category descriptions
  • Homepage sections
  • Email templates

Bulk Content Operations

For multiple products:

  • Generate descriptions in bulk
  • Update content across products
  • Apply templates

Content Preview

Always preview content before publishing:

  1. Make edits
  2. Click Preview
  3. Review on different devices
  4. Publish when ready

Next Steps

After managing content:

  • Add products with descriptions
  • Organize products by categories
